verdict.rationale: Vercel ships a downloadable OpenAPI description of its REST API. A hands-on probe fetched https://vercel.com/openapi.json with HTTP 200, and the file contains an "openapi" key. Vercel's llms.txt also links the REST API OpenAPI description (openapi.vercel.sh) and explicitly tells agents to read it before calling the API. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs describing the spec's coverage and versioning, and independent community corroboration of the spec's completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://vercel.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
For REST API calls, read the OpenAPI description and authentication documentation before choosing an operation.
